title: hub M1: mimi-mls hub-facing Observer/wire accessors
description: mimi-mls: staged-commit detail (proposal kind, sender, by-reference, ProposalRef; Add identity + KeyPackageRef; Remove target leaf + identity), committer identity incl. external joiner, credential identity change detection, ProposalRef of a processed proposal, full GroupInfo verification, MLSMessage group_id/epoch/PrivateMessage authenticated_data accessors, hub Ed25519 keygen + randomness helpers (H16). Files observer.rs, member.rs, wire/rfc9420.rs, label.rs. Oracle: mls-rs computes refs/epoch/group_id independently. Tests: identity change in UpdatePath reported; hostile input never panics. See the .6 design field (approved plan) and decisions .6.1-.6.21.
